# Luís Cunha

[Molecular ecologist reading soil biodiversity through genomes, from volcanic islands to Amazonian dark earths and European farmland.]{.lede}

Coordinating Researcher at the Centre for Functional Ecology, University of Coimbra, where I lead the [Environmental Genomics Laboratory (EnGeL)](https://envigenomics.eu). I turn field samples into sequence data and sequence data into indicators that soil policy can use.

## What I bring

::: {.bring}
::: {}
### Research leadership
Work-package leader and UC coordinator in the Horizon Europe project BENCHMARKS (harmonised soil-health monitoring across Europe). Coordinator of EnGeL at UC Biotech and co-coordinator of the Soil Health research line (CFE) and of Thematic Line 2 of the TERRA associate laboratory. [Projects](projects.qmd)
:::

::: {}
### Genomics in the field and at the bench
High-throughput sequencing (Nanopore and Illumina) for metabarcoding, metagenomics, RNA-Seq and genome assembly, with reproducible pipelines in R and Python. The lab's methods are open as a [protocol handbook](https://luiscunhamx.github.io/EnGeL-Repository/). [Research](research.qmd)
:::

::: {}
### Teaching and mentoring
Fellow of the Higher Education Academy (FHEA). Lecturer in Ecology at the University of South Wales before joining Coimbra; I now teach in the University of Coimbra's international MSc programmes and supervise doctoral and master's students. [Teaching & supervision](teaching.qmd)
:::
:::
